# Fin Evals’ workflow boundary


By OpenTools Team


·


November 6, 2026


Handoff isn’t downstream execution.


##


Transition


Intercom says[new workspaces won’t see Batch Test navigation](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/15899411-fin-evals-explained) from November 5; existing users keep access. Evals score multi‑turn Simulations with an LLM judge.


[Started Simulations](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/15899411-fin-evals-explained) consume the workspace’s monthly allowance, including stopped runs.


##


Checks


Set an[explicit Handoff check](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/18182902-how-to-run-evals-and-read-the-results) ; the hidden No handoff default can fail a correct‑looking reply. Fail means completed but missed checks; Error means incomplete.


A[passing workflow handoff](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/15899411-fin-evals-explained) covers the simulated transfer, not downstream execution. Check that execution separately. Documentation analysis.
